beats.say: In nineteen ninety-six, India and China agreed to exchange maps of the Line of Actual Control.
beats.caption: 1996: agree to swap LAC maps

beats.say: In twenty twenty, at Galwan, India says twenty personnel died; China says casualties on both sides.
beats.caption: Galwan, 2020 · India: 20 died · China: casualties on both sides

beats.say: India says disengagement is complete, with patrols restored at Depsang and Demchok.
beats.caption: India: disengagement complete · patrols back at Depsang, Demchok

beats.say: But elsewhere, India says, steps are temporary and limited, and troop cuts were only agreed for discussion in twenty twenty-five.
beats.caption: Elsewhere: 'temporary and limited' steps · troop cuts: to be discussed (2025)

beats.say: And the line itself? India says some areas lack a common understanding of it.
beats.caption: India: no common understanding of the LAC in some areas

beats.say: Thirty years after the map promise, August twenty twenty-six talks still discussed ways to improve understanding of it.
beats.caption: 1996 → 2026: still discussing the LAC

title: Galwan: What India Says Is Settled, and What Isn't
